# Hand image test fixture

Google AI Edge's public Hand Landmarker notebook uses this sample image:
https://github.com/google-ai-edge/mediapipe-samples/blob/main/examples/hand_landmarker/python/hand_landmarker.ipynb

Original: https://storage.googleapis.com/mediapipe-tasks/hand_landmarker/woman_hands.jpg

Used only to test actual model detection through a synthetic camera stream; not a
product asset or evidence of live hand accuracy. No identity inference is performed.
